info.title: CriptoNous x402
info.description: CriptoNous x402 — pay-per-query crypto market reading with cited sources. You get DEX pair flow (accumulation or distribution; not a named whale, company, or ETF unless a public label exists), narrative heat with the source named, regime context, and a committee reading with dissent. If the ticker is not this contract, the reading says so. First buy: hermes.pulse $0.02 · pair flow poseidon.flow $0.05 · confluence swarm.pulse $0.12 · day loop session.24h $9 (12 reads ≤ $1). Settle: Solana USDC · Base USDC · BNB · Robinhood USDG. ETH L1 deferred_gas — pay via Base (eip155:8453). AccessPass + HMAC receipts (notFiscal). NFA — analysis only; never a trade order, execution, or custody. Manifest /.well-known/x402 · skill.md · llms.txt.
info.x-guidance: CriptoNous x402 market reading with cited sources: pair accumulation vs distribution (not a named whale unless a public label) · narrative heat · regime · confluence with dissent. First buy: GET /x402/resource/hermes.pulse ($0.02) → HTTP 402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (PayAI / Dexter / OpenFacilitator) or PayBox. Pair flow next: poseidon.flow $0.05 · confluence swarm.pulse $0.12 · smoke kit sum $0.19 (no discount). Day loop: session.24h $9 → 12 reads ≤ $1. Templo MCP: POST /x402/mcp/temple_request_tribute {"sku"} then pay + temple_verify + X-PAYMENT; consume via temple_consume_pass — never pay twice. Rails: Solana USDC · Base · BNB · Robinhood USDG. Discovery: /.well-known/x402 · /skill.md (Buy now) · /llms.txt · /x402/hello. NFA — analysis only; no trade execution.
